accelerator physics, as well as studies in medical and space science. The
three main reference papers for Geant4 are published in Nuclear Instruments
and Methods in Physics Research [A 506 (2003) 250-303](http://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0168900203013688),
IEEE Transactions on Nuclear Science [53 No. 1 (2006) 270-278](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/xpls/abs_all.jsp?isnumber=33833&arnumber=1610988&count=33&index=7)
and Nuclear Instruments and Methods in Physics Research [A 835 (2016) 186-225](http://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0168900216306957).

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "11.4.2"
  # Geant4 writes find_dependency(CLHEP <version> EXACT CONFIG) into the
  # Geant4Config.cmake it installs, so this choice is inherited by everything
  # built against the package. Use the version upstream verified this release
  # with, from the "Supported CLHEP, VecGeom and PTL versions" section of
  # https://github.com/Geant4/geant4/blob/v${{ version }}/ReleaseNotes/ReleaseNotes.11.4.html
  clhep_version: "2.4.7.2"

recipe:
  name: geant4
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/Geant4/geant4/archive/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: f381f461e31fdcfccf28a5e48b420d61ba66adbf55d266e3691277bab04eb270
  target_directory: src
  patches:
    # g4tools takes the HDF5 1.6 code path on HDF5 2.x because its version
    # guard only bounds the minor version. Submitted upstream.
    - patches/0001-g4tools-fix-hdf5-2-version-guard.patch
    # Without this, geant4-config --check-datasets looks only at the paths
    # baked in at configure time and reports NOTFOUND for datasets supplied
    # through G4LEDATA and friends, as the geant4-data-* packages do.
    - patches/0002-geant4-config-honour-dataset-env-vars.patch

build:
  number: 1
  skip:
    - win
    # The global pinning carries one clhep per supported Geant4 release; build
    # against ours and leave the others to the feedstock branches that want them.
    - clhep != clhep_version

outputs:
  - staging:
      name: geant4-toolkit
    build:
      script:
        file: build_geant4
        env:
          GEANT4_USE_QT: ${{ "ON" if geant4_variant == "qt" else "OFF" }}
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
        - if: build_platform != target_platform and geant4_variant == "qt"
          then: qt6-main
      host:
        - clhep
        - expat
        - freetype
        - hdf5
        - xerces-c
        - zlib
        - if: geant4_variant == "qt"
          then: qt6-main
        - if: linux
          then:
            - libgl-devel
            - xorg-libx11
            - xorg-libxmu

  - package:
      name: geant4
    inherit: geant4-toolkit
    build:
      # Selectable as e.g. `geant4=*=noqt_*`.
      string: ${{ geant4_variant }}_${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}
      variant:
        # Qt is the default.
        down_prioritize_variant: ${{ 0 if geant4_variant == "qt" else 1 }}
      files:
        - bin/geant4-config
        - bin/geant4.csh
        - bin/geant4.sh
        - include/Geant4/**
        - lib/Geant4-${{ version }}/**
        - lib/cmake/Geant4/**
        - lib/libG4*
        - lib/pkgconfig/G4ptl.pc
        - share/Geant4/fonts/**
        - share/Geant4/geant4make/**
        - share/Geant4/tools.license
      dynamic_linking:
        overlinking_behavior: error
        overdepending_behavior: error
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('geant4-qt-mutex', exact=True) }}
        - if: linux
          then: libgl-devel
        # GEANT4 data packages, versions are taken from:
        # https://github.com/Geant4/geant4/blob/v${{ version }}/cmake/Modules/G4DatasetDefinitions.cmake
        # NB: For robustness, add a trailing ".0" if the version does not have a patch number.
        - geant4-data-abla =3.3.0
        - geant4-data-channeling =2.0.0
        - geant4-data-emlow =8.8.0
        - geant4-data-ensdfstate =3.0.0
        - geant4-data-incl =1.3.0
        - geant4-data-ndl =4.7.1
        - geant4-data-particlexs =4.2.0
        - geant4-data-photonevaporation =6.1.2
        - geant4-data-pii =1.3.0
        - geant4-data-radioactivedecay =6.1.2
        - geant4-data-realsurface =2.2.0
        - geant4-data-saiddata =2.0.0
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('geant4', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          strict: true
          bin:
            - geant4-config
          files:
            exists:
              - bin/geant4.csh
              - bin/geant4.sh
              - include/Geant4/G4Version.hh
              - include/Geant4/**
              - lib/Geant4-${{ version }}/**
              - lib/cmake/Geant4/Geant4Config.cmake
              - lib/cmake/Geant4/**
              - lib/libG4*
              - lib/pkgconfig/G4ptl.pc
              - share/Geant4/fonts/**
              - share/Geant4/geant4make/geant4make.sh
              - share/Geant4/geant4make/**
              - share/Geant4/tools.license
              # Added to the package by tests[].files.recipe below.
              - etc/conda/test-files/**
            not_exists:
              - share/Geant4/examples/**
      - script:
          file: test_geant4
          env:
            GEANT4_USE_QT: ${{ "ON" if geant4_variant == "qt" else "OFF" }}
            GEANT4_CLHEP_VERSION: ${{ clhep_version }}
        requirements:
          build:
            - ${{ compiler('c') }}
            - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
            - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
            - cmake
            - ninja
          run:
            - expat
            - freetype
            - zlib
            - if: geant4_variant == "qt"
              then: qt6-main
            - if: linux
              then:
                - libgl-devel
                - xorg-libx11
                - xorg-libxmu
        files:
          recipe:
            - test_cmake/
    about:
      summary: Geant4 is a toolkit for the simulation of the passage of particles through matter.

  - package:
      name: geant4-examples
    build:
      # The examples are copied verbatim out of the tarball and are identical
      # on every platform.
      noarch: generic
      skip: geant4_variant != "qt"
      variant:
        # Unused here, but conda-smithy only gives a variant its own CI job when
        # every output names it. Drop this and hdf5 migrations build serially.
        use_keys:
          - hdf5
        # Keep the hash platform-independent: the compilers below are only used
        # by the test, and every job must produce the same noarch package.
        ignore_keys:
          - c_compiler
          - c_compiler_version
          - cxx_compiler
          - cxx_compiler_version
          - c_stdlib
          - c_stdlib_version
          - MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET
          - MACOSX_SDK_VERSION
          - macos_machine
      script:
        file: install_examples
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('geant4', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          strict: true
          files:
            exists:
              - share/Geant4/examples/README.md
              - share/Geant4/examples/basic/B1/exampleB1.cc
              - share/Geant4/examples/**
      - script:
          file: test_examples
        requirements:
          build:
            - ${{ compiler('c') }}
            - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
            - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
            - cmake
            - ninja
          run:
            - expat
            - freetype
            - zlib
            - if: geant4_variant == "qt"
              then: qt6-main
            - if: linux
              then:
                - libgl-devel
                - xorg-libx11
                - xorg-libxmu
    about:
      summary: Basic, extended and advanced example applications for Geant4

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  - package:
      name: geant4-qt-mutex
    build:
      # Qt is compiled into libG4interfaces, libG4OpenGL, libG4RayTracer and
      # libG4ToolsSG, so it cannot be a package of its own. The toolkit is built
      # both ways instead; the two builds write the same files, and this
      # metapackage makes that exclusivity visible to the solver. Pin the choice
      # with e.g. `geant4-qt-mutex=*=noqt_1`.
      string: ${{ geant4_variant }}_${{ build_number }}
      variant:
        down_prioritize_variant: ${{ 0 if geant4_variant == "qt" else 1 }}
        # See geant4-examples above.
        use_keys:
          - hdf5
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          strict: true
    about:
      summary: Metapackage selecting whether geant4 is built with Qt support

about:
  homepage: https://geant4.web.cern.ch/
  repository: https://github.com/Geant4/geant4
  documentation: https://geant4.web.cern.ch/support
  license: LicenseRef-Geant4
  license_file: src/LICENSE
  summary: Geant4 is a toolkit for the simulation of the passage of particles through matter.
  description: |
    Geant4 is a toolkit for the simulation of the passage of particles through
    matter. Its areas of application include high energy, nuclear and
    accelerator physics, as well as studies in medical and space science. The
    three main reference papers for Geant4 are published in Nuclear Instruments
    and Methods in Physics Research [A 506 (2003) 250-303](http://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0168900203013688),
    IEEE Transactions on Nuclear Science [53 No. 1 (2006) 270-278](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/xpls/abs_all.jsp?isnumber=33833&arnumber=1610988&count=33&index=7)
    and Nuclear Instruments and Methods in Physics Research [A 835 (2016) 186-225](http://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0168900216306957).
